description: Hybrid application for demolition of existing buildings, to include a Full application for:- 178 residential dwellings (C3 use), flexible uses including retail (A1 use) or cafe (A3 use) or community centre (D1 use), car parking, public space, landscaping and associated works; and an Outline application for:- up to 762 residential dwellings (C3 use) and associated car parking, public space, landscaping and associated works, with all matters to be reserved except means of access.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not be commenced until a written planning obligation under Section 106 Town and Country Planning Act 1990 in the same terms or substantially in the same terms as the substantive draft version annexed hereto has been entered into by all relevant parties in relation to that relevant part of the application site and until the obligation has been completed and submitted to the local planning authority.
Condition : 2 - The development of Phase 1 hereby approved shall be begun no later than the expiration of 3 years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application Full detailed Phase 1 and Outline Phase 2 and the plans submitted (listed above) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Application for approval of the reserved matters for the Outline elements shall be made to the Local Planning Authority before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 5 - The development of Phase 2 hereby permitted shall be begun either before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission, or before the expiration of two years from the date of approval of the last of the reserved matters to be approved, whichever is the later.

Condition : 6 - Approval of the details of the layout, scale, appearance and landscaping of the site (hereinafter called the "Reserved Matters") for the Outline elements shall be obtained from the Local Planning Authority in writing before any development of Phase 2 (excluding demolition, archaeological investigations, ground condition investigations and intrusive site surveys and other enabling works: site clearance; soil storage; remedial works in respect of any contamination or any other adverse ground conditions; erection of any temporary means of enclosure and land raising) is commenced.

Condition : 7 - The outline development hereby granted approval (Phase 2) and any subsequent Reserved Matters shall not exceed the maximum parameters with regards to footprint, height, floorspace, use, volume and location of public space, highways and car parking as shown on the approved plans:
Parameter Plans Ref: 1018_00_07_010, 1018_00_07_011, 1018_00_07_012, 1018_00_07_013, 1018_00_07_014_P02, 1018_00_07_015_P02, 1018_00_07_016_P02, 1018_00_07_017_P02, 1018_00_07_018_P02, 1018_00_07_019_P02, 1018_00_07_020_P02

Condition : 8 - All dwellings that form part of the outline development hereby granted approval (Phase 2) shall be designed in accordance with the London Plan draft Housing SPG (2015), or such other adopted guidance in place at the time of submission of the Reserved Matters.

Condition : 9 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 8am to 4pm on Saturdays and not at all on Sundays and Public Holidays.

Condition : 10 - Development of a Block shall not commence until a Construction and Phasing Programme for the demolition, construction, completion and occupation for the relevant Block has been submitted and approved by the LPA.
Condition : 11 - All construction and demolition works associated with Phase 1 shall be undertaken in accordance with the Construction Logistics Plan (CLP) hereby approved.

Condition : 13 - (A).	Development of a Block shall not commence (except demolition, archaeological investigations, ground condition investigations and intrusive site surveys and other enabling works: site clearance; soil storage; remedial works in respect of any contamination or any other adverse ground conditions; erection of any temporary means of enclosure and land raising) until a scheme for the storage and collection of waste and materials to be recycled in that Block has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
(B).	No Block shall be occupied until the waste and recycling facilities approved under Part (A) of this condition have been provided and made available for use by residents of that Block. Such facilities shall remain throughout the lifetime of the development and shall be used for no other purposes.
Condition : 15 - Each residential unit shall meet M4(2) Building Regulations as shown on the hereby approved plans.

Condition : 16 - A minimum 10% 'Wheelchair User Dwellings' built to Building Regulations M4(3) standard shall be provided. This shall include a minimum of 18 units provided within Phase 1 of the hereby approved development.

Condition : 17 - The scheme shall be constructed in accordance with the principles of the design codes as referred to in the Design and Access Statement (Chapter 4, 5 and 6) prepared by Allies and Morrison.

Condition : 18 - (A). No development (except demolition, archaeological investigations, ground condition investigations and intrusive site surveys and other enabling works: site clearance; soil storage; remedial works in respect of any contamination or any other adverse ground conditions; erection of any temporary means of enclosure and land raising) shall take place on any Block until a scheme of acoustic insulation and any other necessary means of ventilation provided, taking into consideration the recommendations of the Noise & Vibration Chapter of the Environmental Statement, is submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. Such a scheme shall include details of measures to ensure the residential accommodation does not exceed the 'good' limits contained in BS8233:2014. Any works that form part of such a scheme shall be completed as approved before any part of the development within the relevant Block is first occupied. 
(B). Prior to any Block of the development being occupied, the internal ambient noise levels shall be tested against the existing background noise levels at the date of this decision to demonstrate compliance by that Block with the scheme approved under Part A of this condition and shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 19 - Prior to the occupation of any Block, evidence (schedule of fittings and manufacturers' literature), demonstrating that the development of that Block has been constructed to achieve an internal water consumption of the development not exceeding 105 l/p/day in line with The Water Efficiency Calculator for new dwellings issued by the Department of Communities and Local Government, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 20 - Prior to commencement of each Block (except demolition, archaeological investigations, ground condition investigations and intrusive site surveys and other enabling works: site clearance; soil storage; remedial works in respect of any contamination or any other adverse ground conditions; erection of any temporary means of enclosure and land raising), details of: 
- drainage designs (including drawings) which demonstrate that surface water runoff from the site will be restricted to a rate of no greater than 66.9 l/s for storm events of up to and including 1 in 100 year (plus climate change) return periods. This should also demonstrate the sustainable drainage system features proposed in the December 2015 Flood Risk Assessment and the 17th February 2016 Addendum Letter will be constructed to provide the necessary attenuation. This will thereby reduce the risk of surface water flooding to and from the site and increase the water quality, biodiversity and amenity benefits through the use of rainwater harvesting and above ground features, including permeable paving wherever possible; and
- a management plan(s) for the routine maintenance of the development's drainage system for all of the above and below-ground drainage features,
shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Such measures shall be implemented and maintained for the lifetime of the development, or as otherwise set out in the approved management plan(s).

Condition : 21 - Development (except demolition, archaeological investigations, ground condition investigations and intrusive site surveys and other enabling works: site clearance; soil storage; remedial works in respect of any contamination or any other adverse ground conditions; erection of any temporary means of enclosure and land raising) of a Block shall not commence until impact studies of the existing water supply infrastructure have been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority (in consultation with Thames Water). The studies should determine the magnitude of any new additional capacity required in the system and a suitable connection point. Any mitigation measures identified in the studies shall be implemented prior to the first occupation of the development.

Condition : 22 - No piling of a Phase shall take place until a piling method statement (detailing the depth and type of piling to be undertaken and the methodology by which such piling will be carried out, including measures to prevent and minimise the potential for damage to subsurface sewerage infrastructure, and the programme for the works) for that Phase has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority (in consultation with Thames Water).  Any piling must be undertaken in accordance with the terms of the approved piling method statement.

Condition : 23 - Development (except demolition, archaeological investigations, ground condition investigations and intrusive site surveys and other enabling works: site clearance; soil storage; remedial works in respect of any contamination or any other adverse ground conditions; erection of any temporary means of enclosure and land raising) of a Block shall not commence until a drainage strategy detailing any on and/or off site drainage works, has been submitted to and approved by, the Local Planning Authority (in consultation with the sewerage undertaker). No discharge of foul or surface water from the site shall be accepted into the public system until the drainage works referred to in the strategy have been completed for the relevant phase..

Condition : 24 - No development (except demolition to ground level and erection of temporary means of enclosure) shall take place on any Phase until an archaeological Stage 1 Written Scheme of Investigation (WSI) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The programme and methodology of site evaluation for land included within the WSI, including the nomination of a competent person(s) or organisation to undertake the agreed works, must then be carried out in accordance with the approved WSI. 
If heritage assets of archaeological interest are identified through the Stage 1 WSI, then no further development shall take place for those parts of the site which have archaeological interest until a Stage 2 WSI is submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development on land included within the Stage 2 WSI must then be carried out in accordance with the approved Stage 2 WSI, which shall include: 
A.	The statement of significance and research objectives, the programme and methodology of site investigation and recording and the nomination of a competent person(s) or organisation to undertake the agreed works. 
B.	The programme for post-investigation assessment and subsequent analysis, publication and dissemination and deposition of resulting material.

Condition : 25 - Before the development (except demolition, archaeological investigations, ground condition investigations and intrusive site surveys and other enabling works: site clearance; soil storage; remedial works in respect of any contamination or any other adverse ground conditions; erection of any temporary means of enclosure and land raising) of a Phase hereby permitted commences:
(A).	A contaminated land Stage 1 desk study report shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority for that Phase.  Should the Stage 1 report recommend that a Stage 2 site investigation is required, then this shall be carried out and submitted to, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The site shall be investigated by a competent person to identify the extent and nature of contamination. The report should include a tiered risk assessment of the contamination based on the proposed end use of the site.  Additional investigation may be required where it is deemed necessary.
(B).	If required, a scheme for remediation of the site shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority, for written approval.  The scheme shall account for any comments made by the Local Planning Authority before the development hereby permitted is first occupied.
During the course of the development:
(C).	The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for remediation in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues.  
Before the development is first brought into use:
(D).	The agreed scheme for remediation referred to in clauses b) and c) above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.

Condition : 26 - Prior to the occupation of any unit within Phase 1 of the development, evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) to demonstrate that the development of that Phase has been carried out in accordance with the approved Energy Statement, and a reduction in CO2 emissions has been achieved in accordance with the energy strategy hereby approved, shall be submitted to and approved in writing, by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 27 - (A). Prior to any commencement of Phase 2 (except demolition, archaeological investigations, ground condition investigations and intrusive site surveys and other enabling works: site clearance; soil storage; remedial works in respect of any contamination or any other adverse ground conditions; erection of any temporary means of enclosure and land raising), a detailed scheme of the feasibility of on-site sustainability measures for each Block shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Such a scheme shall address each stage of the energy heirarchy; 'Be Lean', 'Be Clean' and 'Be Green' and demonstrate that a CO2 emissions reduction of 35% over Building Regulations Part L 2013 will be achieved.
(B). Prior to the occupation of any unit within Phase 2 of the development, evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) to demonstrate that the development of that Phase has been carried out in accordance with the approved energy strategy (Part (A)), and a reduction in CO2 emissions has been achieved in accordance with the energy strategy approved, shall be submitted to and approved in writing, by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 28 - A). No development (except demolition, archaeological investigations, ground condition investigations and intrusive site surveys and other enabling works: site clearance; soil storage; remedial works in respect of any contamination or any other adverse ground conditions; erection of any temporary means of enclosure and land raising) shall take place on any Block until full details demonstrating how the approved scheme has been designed to allow for the future connection to any neighbouring district heat network have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority 
B). No Block of the development shall be occupied until evidence demonstrating that the approved scheme under Part (A) of this condition has been implemented, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved design details and no alterations shall take place without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 29 - (A) No development (except demolition, archaeological investigations, ground condition investigations and intrusive site surveys and other enabling works: site clearance; soil storage; remedial works in respect of any contamination or any other adverse ground conditions; erection of any temporary means of enclosure and land raising) shall take place on any Block until details for that Block have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority demonstrating that: 
- At least three of the key elements of the building envelope (external walls, windows roof, upper floor slabs, internal walls, floor finishes/coverings) are to achieve a rating of A+ to D in the Building Research Establishment (BRE) Green Guide to Specification; 
- At least 50% of timber and timber products are to be sourced from accredited Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) or Programme for the Endorsement of Forestry Certification (PEFC) scheme; and 
- No construction or insulation materials are to be used which will release toxins into the internal and external environment, including those that deplete stratospheric ozone. 
(B) The buildings in that Block shall not be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with the approved details.
Condition : 30 - Development of a Block shall not commence until a Tree Protection Plan (TPP) in respect of the existing trees within the site has been submitted to and approved by the Council.

Condition : 32 - Development of a Block shall not commence (except demolition, archaeological investigations, ground condition investigations and intrusive site surveys and other enabling works: site clearance; soil storage; remedial works in respect of any contamination or any other adverse ground conditions; erection of any temporary means of enclosure and land raising),until a Biodiversity Enhancement Strategy, incorporting the recommendations of the Ecology chapter of the Environmental Statement and the incorporation of at least 19 bird boxes, 14 bat boxes and 3 log piles, has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Any enhancement measures shall be maintained throughout the lifetime of the development or in accordance with the strategy set out in the Ecological Management Plan.

Condition : 33 - Prior to the occupation of any unit within Phase 1 of the development, a Delivery & Servicing Plan for the non-residential use at 88 Lampton Road shall be submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Such a Plan shall include details of delivery and service vehicles tracking to minimise conflict with the relocated H20 bus stand.

Condition : 34 - Prior to the occupation of any Block of the development, a Car Park Management Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. This shall cover details of:
- Accessible car parking spaces for people with disabilities;
- Electric vehicle charging points (20% active & 20% passive) 
- How the uptake in electric vehicle charing points is monitored to bring into use passive charging points when required;
- Measures to maximise car parking use within undercroft car parks through allocation of spaces 
- Means to advise residents that if they apply for a parking permit it is not a guarantee of a parking space
The car park management plan shall then be implemented as approved and remain in operation thereafter.

Condition : 35 - Prior to the occupation of any unit within a Block (of Phase 1), any residential cycle storage for that Block shall be made available for use in accordance with the provision indicated on the approved plans, with the exception of cycle stores associated with Blocks A and B which shall be redesigned and constructed so as not to accommodate more than 50 stands per store. This storage shall consist of a horizontal storage arrangement to ensure accessibility for all residents and where double stack arrangements, these shall be provided with a mechanical or pneumatic assisted lift (or such equivalent provision). The cycle stores shall then be maintained as such thereafter.

Condition : 36 - Details of the layout, design and appearance (shown in context) of the bicycle storage area(s) for Phase 2, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the development (except demolition, archaeological investigations, ground condition investigations and intrusive site surveys and other enabling works: site clearance; soil storage; remedial works in respect of any contamination or any other adverse ground conditions; erection of any temporary means of enclosure and land raising) of Phase 2. This storage shall consist of a horizontal storage arrangement to ensure accessibility for all residents and where double stack arrangements these shall be provided with a mechanical or pneumatic assisted lift (or such equivalent provision).
The bicycle storage area(s) shall be provided strictly in accordance with the details so approved and shall be provided/erected prior to the first occupation of any part of that Phase, and maintained as such thereafter.

Condition : 37 - Prior to the first occupation of a Block, the parking, loading and turning spaces for that Block as set out in the approved plans, shall be constructed and made available for use. The parking, loading and turning spaces shall then be retained as such and shall not be used for any other purposes thereafter.

Condition : 38 - Prior to the first occupation of a Block, the means of pedestrian and vehicular access for that Block hereby approved shall be constructed in accordance with the approved plans and made available for use and any redundant access points shall be closed with the re-instatement of kerbs and footway, to the satisfaction of the Local Highway Authority.

Condition : 39 - Prior to commencement of a Phase (except demolition, archaeological investigations, ground condition investigations and intrusive site surveys and other enabling works: site clearance; soil storage; remedial works in respect of any contamination or any other adverse ground conditions; erection of any temporary means of enclosure and land raising), details of all highways works to be undertaken within that Phase as part of a S.278 agreement shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, including details of the relcation of the bus stand (H20) and bus stop (120). Such works shall be substantially completed to the satisfaction of the Council prior to first occupation of that Phase.

Condition : 40 - Pedestrian visibility splays as shown on the approved plans either side of the vehicular accesses on Lampton Road shall be provided prior to first occupation of the development and maintained as such thereafter with nothing over 600mm in these regions.
Condition : 41 - 41.	Entry and exit signage corresponding to the appropriate vehicle access shall be provided prior to occupation of any part of the development and maintained as such thereafter.
Condition : 42 - No building or structure of the development hereby permitted shall exceed 87m Above Ordnance Datum (AOD).

Condition : 43 - The development is close to the aerodrome and/or aircraft taking off from or landing at the aerodrome.  Lighting schemes required during construction and for the completed development shall be of a flat glass, full cut off design, mounted horizontally or below the horizontal, and shall ensure that there is no light spill above the horizontal.

Condition : 44 - No development (except demolition, archaeological investigations, ground condition investigations and intrusive site surveys and other enabling works: site clearance; soil storage; remedial works in respect of any contamination or any other adverse ground conditions; erection of any temporary means of enclosure and land raising) shall take place on any Block until a Bird Hazard Management Plan in respect of the buildings within that Block has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The submitted plan shall include details of: 
- management of any flat/shallow pitched/green roofs on buildings within the site which may be attractive to nesting, roosting and loafing birds. The management plan shall comply with Advice Note 8 Potential Bird Hazard from Building Design. 
The Bird Hazard Management Plan shall then be implemented in accordance with the approved details on completion of development of that phase and shall remain in force for the life of the development.

Condition : 45 - Prior to the commencement of any A3 use within the development, a scheme for the control of noise, fumes and odours for that unit, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and a detailed assessment of the effectiveness of the scheme, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall then be implemented as approved before the use of the relevant unit commences and shall be retained as such thereafter.

Condition : 46 - Prior to installation, details of any external ventilation equipment within the Block, including ducting and any necessary noise attenuation measures, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The works shall then be carried out in accordance with the approved details before that Block is first occupied. Plant shall be set in from the roof boundaries by a minimum of 2m.

Condition : 47 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no fences, gates or walls shall be erected within the curtilage of any dwellinghouse forward of any wall of that dwellinghouse which fronts onto a road.

Condition : 48 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no windows/dormer windows other than those expressly authorised by this permission shall be constructed or installed.

Condition : 49 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings other than those expressly authorised by this permission shall be shall be carried out.

Condition : 50 - Any A1/A3 uses hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times: 8:00am to 11:00pm Monday to Saturday, 10:00am to 11:00pm Sundays, Bank Holidays and Public Holidays.

Condition : 51 - No deliveries to any A1 or A3 use shall be taken at or dispatched from the site outside the hours of 07.00 hours to 18.00 hours Monday to Saturday nor outside the hours of 09.00 hours to 14.00 hours on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.
Condition : 52 - No amplified or other music played in or from the Class A3 use shall be audible within the nearest residential unit.
